subject: Medistaff: ID access evidence & procurement timeline
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Porter <lisa.porter@medistaff.com>, procurement@medistaff.com
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-29T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Medistaff: ID access evidence & procurement timeline

Hi Lisa — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so procurement and your security team have a single reference.

Call highlights (from product/security discovery):
- Medistaff will be using Redwood for user-facing clinical summarization features (low-latency inference).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 status and timeframe, GDPR data residency/processing, and HIPAA applicability for the clinical tenant.
- IAM details needed: SSO (SAML 2.0) support, SCIM provisioning cadence, RBAC (admin vs. manager vs. user roles), and audit/logging for admin actions.

What we need from you to move procurement/security review along:
1) SOC 2: copy of the most recent report or interim statement and expected date for Type II if currently in progress.
2) GDPR/HIPAA: confirmation of the data processing addendum (DPA) needs and whether PHI will be stored/processed in the workload you described.
3) IAM evidence: please complete the attached ID evidence template with the following:
   - SSO: supported IdP metadata (entityID, ACS URL), SAML attributes sent (email, first_name, last_name, roles)
   - SCIM: supported endpoints and whether we can enable incremental provisioning (PATCH)
   - Admin controls: how to create admin accounts, separation of duties, and audit log retention for admin events
4) Procurement: point of contact and expected PO/contract timeline (we can prepare a standard SOW once security items are confirmed).

Deliverables we attached: redwood-id-evidence-template.xlsx (single-sheet intake) — please fill and return to kimberly_park@redwood.com. If easier, we can schedule a short technical call to walk through SAML metadata exchange.

Proposed schedule:
- Medistaff returns completed template + any SOC/DPA artifacts by Fri 2027-09-03
- Technical SAML/SCIM call week of 2027-09-06 (30–45 min)
- Contract/PO targeted by end of September if security intake is complete

If any of the dates are unrealistic, please propose alternatives. Thanks — looking forward to moving this to procurement.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

From: Lisa Porter <lisa.porter@medistaff.com>

Subject: Re: Medistaff: ID access evidence & procurement timeline

Hi Kimberly — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers and next steps from our side:  

1) SOC 2: we are currently SOC 2 Type II in-progress; expected completion date is mid-November 2027. I attached our current security questionnaire export (partial) — it's not the final report but will help.
2) GDPR/HIPAA: we are GDPR-compliant for EU patient data and have a DPA template we use. HIPAA — the clinical tenant will handle PHI, so we will need a BAA; please flag that to legal.
3) IAM: we support SAML 2.0 (IdP initiated and SP metadata available), SCIM v2 with support for PATCH, and we have a 3-role RBAC model (admin / clinician_manager / clinician_user). Audit logs for admin changes are kept for 12 months.

Procurement: procurement@medistaff.com is looping in our vendor team. PO timeline is typically 4–6 weeks after SOW review.

We'll aim to return the completed template by 2027-09-03. If we need a walkthrough for SAML attributes, send a calendar invite and we can have one of our engineers join.

Thanks,
Lisa Porter
Director of Product Security | MediStaff Health
lisa.porter@medistaff.com
